speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two-and-twenty today, at Holborn or wherever the court lies. The year before last I sent a book with a name on the front of it. Last year another. This year nothing goes, and it will not be missed, and that's the whole of the matter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. The whole of the matter is that I've a girl waiting for night in the third act and must be at Shoreditch by nine.
